name: CMOS 2-Input NAND Gate
description: Static CMOS 2-input NAND gate. Pull-up network: two parallel PMOS devices (M_PU1, M_PU2) — output HIGH when either input is LOW. Pull-down network: two series NMOS devices (M_ND1, M_ND2) — output LOW only when both inputs are HIGH. NAND is the universal gate; preferred over NOR in CMOS because the series NMOS stack has higher drive strength than equivalent series PMOS.

High Speed.reasoning: Series NMOS sized 2x to maintain drive strength equal to a single NMOS; PMOS at minimum width for speed.

Low Power.reasoning: Longer channels reduce leakage; acceptable for static control logic paths.

default.reasoning: Series NMOS W = 1.5x single NMOS to compensate for series resistance penalty.

sizing_notes.M_ND1: Series pull-down NMOS — top of stack (connected to output); sized wider than single NMOS due to series stacking.
sizing_notes.M_ND2: Series pull-down NMOS — bottom of stack (connected to GND); same sizing as M_ND1 for symmetric delay.
sizing_notes.M_PU1: Parallel pull-up PMOS — for input A; each PMOS sees full VDD, no stacking penalty.
sizing_notes.M_PU2: Parallel pull-up PMOS — for input B.

kg_nodes.description: NMOS pull-down series connection requires wider devices to match single-transistor drive strength.
